parsed.answer: Both sources explicitly link RAD52 to break-induced replication (BIR). Source 14332945 identifies RAD52 as a top hit in a BIR-related screen and shows Rad52 depletion/knockout compromises restart of collapsed forks during replication stress, proposing mammalian RAD52 facilitates repair of collapsed forks. Source 4899981 states that mitotic DNA synthesis at telomeres and common fragile sites requires RAD52 and is a RAD52-dependent form of break-induced replication.
